headline: Apple lists wireless Mixed-Signal Verification Engineer roles
fact: Apple listed Mixed-Signal Verification Engineer roles for RF and mixed-signal blocks and interfaces in wireless SoCs. The descriptions assign verification planning, mixed-signal and digital UVM testbenches, reusable monitors and checkers, coverage closure, automation, and methodology improvement using AI; real-numbered SystemVerilog behavioral-model experience appears as a preferred qualification.

sources.title: Mixed-Signal Verification Engineer
sources.summary: Official Apple posting dated May 13, 2026, describing RF and mixed-signal SoC verification with UVM, monitors and checkers, coverage, automation, AI-assisted methodology improvement, and preferred real-number modeling experience.
